title: Staff Embedded Software Engineer, Digital Healthcare
desc:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Staff Embedded Software Engineer,
Digital Healthcare
About The Role
As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer within ADI's Digital Healthcare Disease Management team, you will play a critical role in transforming physiological sensing technologies into clinically relevant and wellness-focused solutions. You will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for architecting and developing embedded software platforms that enable health monitoring, disease management, and digital biomarker applications across wearable and medical devices.
This role requires deep expertise in embedded systems, sensor integration, and software architecture, combined with the ability to influence technical strategy across multidisciplinary teams including algorithm, biomedical, hardware, regulatory, product, and customer-facing organizations. You will help bridge the gap between advanced sensing technologies and real-world healthcare solutions that improve patient outcomes and quality of life.
Key Responsibilities
Lead architecture and design of complex embedded software systems for Digital Healthcare Disease Management team
Drive integration of Digital Healthcare algorithms
Drive technical innovation and best practices across teams
Collaborate closely with algorithm, biomedical, hardware, and system engineering teams to translate research innovations into scalable products.
Develop solutions to complex technical problems
Define software architectures that support regulatory, clinical, and commercial requirements across healthcare products.
Provide technical leadership on strategic projects
Mentor and develop technical talent within the organization
Influence cross-functional technical decisions
Drive system-level architecture improvements
Collaborate with business units to align technical solutions with market needs
Must Have Skills
Embedded Systems Architecture: Advanced expertise in designing sophisticated embedded software architectures
Hardware-Software Integration: Deep understanding of hardware-software interfaces and integration challenges
SoC Development: Extensive experience with System-on-Chip development and optimization
Real-Time Signal Processing Systems: Strong experience supporting physiological sensing pipelines, sensor fusion, and real-time data acquisition systems.
Performance and Power Optimization: Expert ability to analyze and optimize complex embedded systems for memory, latency, battery life and overall performance.
Technical Leadership: Proven capability to guide architectural decisions and technical direction
Cross-Functional Influence: Ability to influence decisions across organizational boundaries
Mentoring: Track record of developing technical talent and elevating team capabilities
SW Licensing: Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of various software licensing models, including open-source, proprietary, and hybrid licenses.
CI/CD: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated build and test processes, and integration with version control systems.
Preferred Education And Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred; PhD a plus
7+ years of relevant experience in embedded software development
Proven track record of technical leadership
Experience with complex system architecture
Why You’ll Love Working at ADI
At Analog Devices, you'll be part of a collaborative and innovative team that's shaping the future of Digital Healthcare technology. We offer a supportive environment focused on professional growth, competitive compensation and benefits, work-life balance, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that make a real impact on the world.
Your expertise will shape the future of technology, and you’ll be supported by a culture that values continuous advancement and professional growth. Join us and help create the technologies that bridge the physical and digital worlds, making a tangible difference in how people live, work, and connect.
